claims.description: Images use supported width and height attributes for intrinsic sizing.

notes.text: `img` can use `width` and `height` attributes, with missing dimensions treated as zero for images without a resource.

claims.description: `svg`, `canvas`, `video`, `iframe`, and empty `object` elements use deterministic fallback dimensions.

notes.text: `svg`, `canvas`, `video`, `iframe`, and empty `object` elements use native `300x150` fallback dimensions with `width` and `height` attribute overrides.
`object` elements without `type` or `data` resource hints lay out fallback children.

claims.description: `audio` elements distinguish non-rendered media from controls with deterministic fallback geometry.

notes.text: `audio` elements without `controls` are non-rendered; audio controls use native `300x54` fallback dimensions.

claims.description: Package metadata can provide deterministic intrinsic dimensions for any element.

notes.text: Any element can use `data-layout-width` and `data-layout-height` metadata.
